name: zstd
author: Meta Platforms (zstd), Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler (zlib), the Tukaani project (xz)
description: zstd compresses and decompresses files: Zstandard (.zst), gzip (.gz) and xz (.xz). It answers to zstd, gzip, gunzip, zcat, xz, unxz and xzcat. Type gunzip file.gz.
usage:
zstd: zstd FILE (-> FILE.zst) | zstd -d FILE.zst | zstd -19 FILE | zstd --list FILE.zst
unzstd: unzstd FILE.zst
zstdcat: zstdcat FILE.zst
gzip: gzip [-k] FILE (-> FILE.gz, removes FILE unless -k)
gunzip: gunzip [-k] FILE.gz
zcat: zcat FILE.gz|FILE.xz|FILE.zst (to stdout)
xz: xz [-k] FILE (-> FILE.xz; levels above -1 are capped at 1)
unxz: unxz [-k] FILE.xz
xzcat: xzcat FILE.xz
lzma: lzma FILE
unlzma: unlzma FILE.lzma
No tar: a .tar.gz becomes a .tar.

descriptions.en: zstd compresses and decompresses files: Zstandard (.zst), gzip (.gz) and xz (.xz). It answers to zstd, gzip, gunzip, zcat, xz, unxz and xzcat. Type gunzip file.gz.
descriptions.it: zstd comprime e decomprime file: Zstandard (.zst), gzip (.gz) e xz (.xz). Risponde ai comandi zstd, gzip, gunzip, zcat, xz, unxz e xzcat. Scrivi gunzip file.gz.

does.en: Compress/decompress .zst .gz .xz files. Run: gunzip -k F.gz | zcat F.gz | unxz F.xz | xz -k F | zstd F | zstd -d F.zst (no tar: .tar.gz -> .tar)
does.it: Comprime/decomprime file .zst .gz .xz. Uso: gunzip -k F.gz | zcat F.gz | unxz F.xz | xz -k F | zstd F | zstd -d F.zst (niente tar: .tar.gz -> .tar)
